solutionCode:
def validation_summary(left, right)
  merged = []
  left_index = 0
  right_index = 0
  while left_index < left.length && right_index < right.length
    if left[left_index] <= right[right_index]
      merged << left[left_index]
      left_index += 1
    else
      merged << right[right_index]
      right_index += 1
    end
  end
  merged.concat(left[left_index..] || []).concat(right[right_index..] || []).join(",")
end
hint: Both failures should appear in the summary.
explanation: The broken code stops after the first failing rule. Collecting every failing field fixes the summary.
